summary.title: CodeCrafters | The Hardest Programming Challenges on the Internet
summary.one_liner: CodeCrafters is a paid-style platform of guided challenges where you rebuild real systems such as Redis, Git, and SQLite from scratch in your own language and IDE, with tests run via git push.
takeaways: Rebuild 11 real systems (e.g. Redis, Git, SQLite) from scratch as a structured challenge series
Work in your own language and IDE, then run tests by pushing code with git
Topics covered include TCP servers, the Redis protocol, git objects, storage engines, BitTorrent, shell parsing, and LLM tool calling
Challenges are aimed at experienced engineers rather than algorithm drills
summary.summary: The CodeCrafters homepage promotes a set of programming challenges where users rebuild tools such as Redis, Git, and SQLite from scratch. Each challenge is worked on in the user's own editor and language, and solutions are checked by pushing to a git remote, with results and hints returned quickly. The page lists 11 challenges covering topics like TCP servers, git internals, tokenization and parsing, distributed systems, BitTorrent, regex, and LLM agent loops. Most of the page is testimonials and marketing, so specifics such as pricing and the full language list are not given here.
